title: amendment-atoms v1 proposal atom
description: A single amendment proposal atom. Records a typed, rationale-bearing proposal to change a target document — additive, corrective, breaking, deprecation, or revocation.

target_document.description: Atom ID (with optional @semver) of the document being amended, e.g. constitution-atoms/charter/ai-governance@0.3.0

rationale.description: Why this change is needed. Must name the operational failure, gap, or improvement it addresses.

proposed_text.description: The exact replacement or addition text for the target document section.

effective_date.description: ISO-8601 date on which this amendment takes effect.

proposed_by.description: Identity of the proposer — org slug, user handle, or DID.

superseded_by.description: ID of the amendment that supersedes this one, if status=superseded.
